description.value: Coombs Corner Convenience is a convenience store on the Alberni Highway in Coombs, a small Vancouver Island community sitting between Parksville and Port Alberni. It occupies a natural rest point for cyclists riding the highway corridor toward Pacific Rim National Park or the Comox Valley. As a corner store on a touring route, it offers the kind of quick resupply stop that matters when the next town is many kilometres away.
